Pass evidence and failure action: State problem, contribution, evidence, decisive result, uncertainty, limitation and implication. Cross-check every slide and note against the final manuscript and artefacts.

Check and control: [ ] M — Numbers, units, labels, figures and conclusions are consistent.
Pass evidence and failure action: Check counts, denominators, estimates, uncertainty, axes, legends, table numbers, figure versions and conclusion wording. Scientific mismatch returns to the responsible gate.

Check and control: [ ] R — The strongest sentence remains inside the Claim Gate boundary.
Pass evidence and failure action: Mark the principal claim and strongest unsupported extension. Practise rejecting causality, deployment, fairness, generalisation or institutional readiness claims not established by the design.

Check and control: [ ] R — The deck is readable and accessible under room conditions.
Pass evidence and failure action: Check final-size text, contrast, line density, colour-independent meaning, verbal descriptions, input needs and visibility from the intended room or equivalent display.

Check and control: [ ] M — Citations, rights, personal data and confidential detail are controlled.
Pass evidence and failure action: Cite sources actually used, retain required attributions and remove restricted identifiers, credentials, participant details or unauthorised third-party material.

Check and control: [ ] R — Full, compressed and no-slide narratives and the actual equipment path have passed timed tests.
Pass evidence and failure action: Open the final deck and media on equivalent equipment. Check fonts, aspect ratio, links, audio, adapters, offline access and backups. After freeze, make no hidden scientific change.
